name: Lucid Company
source:
A future when wearable device technology is further developed and Lucid Company is the leading technology company of this era, holding many international patents related to sensory rendering and having a strong social influence. As the protagonist of the story, the player is fortunately selected as a test customer for Lucid Company's new product - adaptive virtual reality but gradually steps into an unknown conspiracy during the tests.

[Translated from [url=https://carboooooooooon.itch.io/lucid-company]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在未来，穿戴式设备技术高度发展，Lucid Company成为时代领先的科技企业，拥有多项与感官渲染有关的国际专利，社会影响力举足轻重。作为故事主角，玩家幸运地成为Lucid Company新产品“自适应虚拟现实”的测试者，却在测试过程中逐步卷入一场未知的阴谋。
